_meta.name: sdxl-illustrious-lora-demo
_meta.description: Illustrious XL + stacked LoRAs (anime-detailer 1.0 quality + midsommar-cartoon 0.8 style). Worked example of the LoraLoader chain pattern — MODEL/CLIP outputs from one LoraLoader feed the inputs of the next, so strengths compose multiplicatively.

2._comment: First LoRA in the stack: anime detailer — boosts line/texture detail.

3._comment: Second LoRA: midsommar cartoon style. Notice model/clip come from node 2, not node 1 — that is the chain.

10._comment: Positive prompt — CLIP comes from the LAST LoraLoader in the chain so all LoRAs are applied.

inputs.text: worst quality, low quality, blurry, jpeg artifacts, watermark, signature, text, bad anatomy, bad hands, extra fingers

30._comment: Sampler — MODEL also comes from the last LoraLoader (node 3) so denoising sees the stacked weights.
